assumptions: Annealing needs an exact 3' seed match; identity is scored over the rest.
limits: 'No sites' means no 3' seed match, not a low score.
Melting temperature is SpliceCraft's fallback, not primer3's.
bio.jane/contract.question: Where does a primer anneal on this molecule, and how well does each site match?

description: Where a primer anneals on the open plasmid: 3'-anchored sites with identity % and the ✓/⚠/~/✗ verdict, graded at a bar you can move and that the answer states. The scan is 3'-anchored, so every site it reports matches the oligo's 3' seed exactly and 'no sites' means no seed match rather than a low score.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

thresholds.description: the identity boundaries the ✓/⚠/~/✗ verdict is cut at. Left unset, the run uses the bar your Primer Library is set to, and with no panel state the upstream SpliceCraft default — either way the bar it used comes back in `thresholds`, because a verdict whose cutoff is not stated cannot be checked. Move it to say what you are asking: screening a pool tolerates a lower `strong` than checking a clone does. Advanced.

exact.description: at or above this identity %, a perfect match — distinguished from a merely strong one. It is 99.999 rather than 100 on purpose: identity is computed as 100 × (L − mm) / L and a cut at 100 drops a perfect match to float rounding. In %.

marginal.description: at or above: ~, marginal. Below it: ✗, not expected to bind. In %.

strong.description: at or above: ✓, the primer is expected to bind here. In %.

weak.description: at or above: ⚠, plausible binding worth checking. In %.

name: primer_check

bestIdentityPct.description: identity of the best site, or 0 when nothing was found — a measurement, never a verdict

bestTier.description: the best site's tier: exact · strong · weak · marginal · none, or unknown when nothing was graded

bindingCount.description: how many sites are at or above the `strong` boundary — the ones expected to bind. More than one is a different experiment from one: a primer with two real sites gives two products, so a single clean band is not what this predicts

siteCount.description: how many sites the seed found at all. Branch on this rather than on the length of `sites`: 0 is a real result and means the oligo's 3' end matches nowhere, not that it binds weakly

sites.description: annealing sites with identity %, mismatches, strand, the 3'-anchored footprint, and each one's tier and what that tier MEANS — read the tier rather than re-deriving it from the percentage, because the bar is a parameter

thresholds.description: the four boundaries every verdict above was made against, and whether they came from your panel or from the upstream default — the same shape the `thresholds` parameter takes, so a run can be repeated at the bar it was graded at
